method: Focal crops copied byte-for-byte from earlier review evidence. Original source index and evidence photo ID cross-checked against the source manifest. Latest ring-boundary decisions are merged by observation ID over the 125-observation re-review while preserving original review indexes; every example category matches the merged decision. Fresh ring-baseline photo metadata supersedes earlier metadata for those records. Each asset identifies its license check source and time. Only CC0, CC BY, and CC BY-NC photo licenses accepted.

Owner correction: a weak pale/white circle is visible encircling the yellow center. The visible band rules out Absent, but its weak outer boundary supports Faint.

Owner correction: a weak pale rim encircles the yellow/orange center. It is visible enough to rule out Absent, but has the soft boundary of Faint. The broader petal paling remains the owner’s Low-variation anchor.
A weak localized basal band is visible but blends softly into violet tissue. Retain Faint; the owner’s Low variation refers to modest broad changes beyond the basal band.
Owner-specified Clear anchor: an obvious white band surrounds the yellow throat, with a traceable outer edge against violet tissue on at least three petal bases.
A localized white band outside the yellow throat has a readily traceable outer edge against saturated violet tissue on at least three petals.
A narrow white band immediately outside the orange throat has an obvious outer edge against pink-lilac tissue on at least three petal bases. Modest variation remains outside that band.

Owner-flagged ambiguity: a broad diffuse pale center blends into violet outer tissue in both photographs. Its poorly defined outer edge does not establish a Clear ring or a separately localized Faint band.
Owner-flagged ambiguity: the diffuse pale inner region lacks an obvious outer edge. The alternate views do not establish whether it is a separate center ring or broad pigment variation.
User-corrected cupped view may hide an inner band; uncertainty retained.
No separate outer ring boundary on white petals.
Nearly uniform broad pink tissue; folds and flecks excluded.
Approximately uniform colored background outside the separate ring.
Approximately uniform white background beyond throat and fine veins.
User-designated Low anchor: broad paler middle regions and stronger pigment toward other petal regions, beyond narrow vein lines; revised from None.
User-designated Low anchor: modest broad lighter and darker regions within the colored petals, without F-like separated zones; revised from None.
Modest broad lighter interiors and more pigmented outer regions repeat beyond the narrow center band; revised to Low.

The pale inner region cannot be separated confidently into a center ring versus broad pigment variation. Excluding it could produce a different score from including it; neither None nor Low/High is justified until that distinction is resolved.
Direct glare and shadows prevent pigment-gradient assessment.
Glare and defocus prevent variation scoring.
Strong differences in illumination prevent attributing broad changes to pigment.
